The sync batch durability notification and durability wait APIs have been implemented and committed to branch `feature/batch-durable` branched off `main`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **[`EventListener.BatchDurable`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/event.go#L1052-L1055) Callback**:
   - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/event.go#L53-L64) carrying `JobID int`, `SeqNum base.SeqNum`, `Err error`, `ApplyDuration time.Duration`, `SyncDuration time.Duration`, `CorrelationID uint64`, `BatchSize int`, and `KeyCount uint32`.
   - Fires exactly once per Sync commit after the WAL sync completes, including on sync failures.
   - Non-sync commits (`WriteOptions.Sync = false`) and `DisableWAL` never trigger the callback.
   - Preserves measured positive wall-clock durations for `ApplyDuration` and `SyncDuration`.
   - Wired properly through [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/event.go#L1250-L1377), [`EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/event.go#L1156-L1170), and [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/event.go#L1246-L1250).

2. **Durability Wait and Query APIs on [`DB`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go)**:
   - [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L299-L303) / [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L305-L394): Blocks until sequence number is durable; seqnum 0 succeeds after any commit becomes durable.
   - [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L396-L400) / [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L402-L419): Blocks until every sequence number in slice is durable; returns `nil` for empty or nil slices.
   - [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L421-L426) / [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L428-L525): Blocks until callback job ID is durable. Returns distinguishable expired error (message contains "expired") if outside the bounded retention window ([`Options.DurabilityJobRetentionWindow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/options.go#L1168-L1170), default 1024), or unknown error (message contains "unknown") for zero or never-seen job IDs.
   - [`DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error)`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L527-L533): Returns highest durable sequence number and first latched WAL sync error.
   - [`DurabilityNotify(base.SeqNum) <-chan error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L535-L573): Returns a receive-only channel delivering `nil` on success or non-nil error on WAL sync failure / DB close. Excess callers beyond [`Options.DurabilityMaxSubscriptions`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/options.go#L1172-L1174) (default 4096) receive an immediate non-nil error.
   - [`DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability.go#L575-L588): Returns a snapshot of `HighestDurableSeqNum`, `FirstErr`, `PendingWaiters`, `TotalDurableCommits`, `TotalFailedCommits`, `CumulativeSyncDuration`, and `MaxSyncDuration`. `PendingWaiters` tracks goroutines blocked in wait APIs.
   - All waiters unblock with error on DB close.
   - When `DisableWAL` is true, all wait APIs and `DurabilityNotify` return `nil` immediately.
   - Durability and DB close errors take precedence over context cancellation.

3. **Metrics**:
   - Added [`Metrics.DurableCommitCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/metrics.go#L382-L385) and [`Metrics.DurableCommitDuration`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/metrics.go#L386-L389) (cumulative WAL sync duration), accumulated only when `BatchDurable` is configured.

4. **Testing and Verification**:
   - Added comprehensive tests in [`durability_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-so0wva4_/durability_test.go) covering callback invocations, failure handling, wait APIs, retention bounds, channel notifications, metrics isolation, and context precedence.
   - All package tests (`go test -short .`) pass cleanly.
   - Changes committed to `feature/batch-durable`.
